BiblicalUsage: Fraud is the word, and it holds fast where it should let go. Jerusalem has slid back by a perpetual backsliding, holding fast deceit and refusing to return; Gaal's men fortify Shechem against Abimelech in treachery; the psalmist says the deceit of those who err is falsehood; and the remnant shall speak no lies, and no deceitful tongue shall be found in their mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that deceit is the sin that refuses to let go: it is held fast in Jerusalem and it is absent from the remnant, and the difference between them is the whole of the story. I believe the word asks me which company I am in — those who hold fast deceit, or those in whose mouth no deceit is found.
